metadata.description: Cloud-development plugins covering AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, IBM, Alibaba, Tencent, plus edge / PaaS / VPS providers (Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, Fly.io, Vercel, Supabase, Render, Railway, Linode, Vultr, Scaleway, Netlify). Domain skills, SME sub-agents, and slash commands for building, reviewing, and migrating cloud workloads.

plugins.name: cloud-aws
plugins.description: AWS development toolkit — domain skills, SME sub-agents, slash commands for IaC scaffolding, health checks, and architecture review.

plugins.name: cloud-gcp
plugins.description: Google Cloud development toolkit — domain skills, SME sub-agents, slash commands for IaC scaffolding, health checks, and architecture review.

plugins.name: cloud-azure
plugins.description: Microsoft Azure development toolkit — domain skills, SME sub-agents, slash commands for IaC scaffolding, health checks, and architecture review.

plugins.name: cloud-oci
plugins.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure development toolkit — Compute, OKE, Object Storage, Autonomous Database, OCI IAM, networking, and observability skills.

plugins.name: cloud-cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare development toolkit — Workers, R2, D1, Pages, Zero Trust, and edge networking skills, with SME sub-agents and slash commands.

plugins.name: cloud-digitalocean
plugins.description: DigitalOcean development toolkit — Droplets, App Platform, DOKS, Spaces, Managed Databases, and networking skills, with SME sub-agents and slash commands.

plugins.name: cloud-hetzner
plugins.description: Hetzner Cloud development toolkit — Hetzner Cloud servers, volumes, networks, load balancers, firewalls, and Robot dedicated infrastructure.

plugins.name: cloud-fly
plugins.description: Fly.io development toolkit — Machines, Apps, Volumes, Postgres, Redis, networking, anycast, scale-to-zero, and global multi-region deployments.

plugins.name: cloud-vercel
plugins.description: Vercel development toolkit — Next.js deployments, Edge Functions, Edge Middleware, Image Optimization, KV / Postgres / Blob, ISR, and monorepos.

plugins.name: cloud-supabase
plugins.description: Supabase development toolkit — Postgres, Auth, Row Level Security, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, Vector / pgvector, migrations, and self-hosting.

plugins.name: cloud-render
plugins.description: Render development toolkit — Web Services, Background Workers, Cron Jobs, Static Sites, Managed Postgres / Redis, Disks, and Blueprints (IaC).

plugins.name: cloud-railway
plugins.description: Railway development toolkit — Services, Volumes, Plugins, Environments, Templates, Cron Jobs, observability, and PR preview deployments.

plugins.name: cloud-linode
plugins.description: Linode (Akamai Cloud Computing) toolkit — Compute Instances, LKE Kubernetes, Object Storage, Managed Databases, NodeBalancer, VLAN, and Cloud Firewalls.

plugins.name: cloud-vultr
plugins.description: Vultr development toolkit — Cloud Compute, Bare Metal, VKE Kubernetes, Object Storage, Managed Databases, Load Balancers, and VPC 2.0.

plugins.name: cloud-scaleway
plugins.description: Scaleway development toolkit — domain skills, SME sub-agents, slash commands for IaC scaffolding and architecture review. EU data residency, Kapsule, Serverless Containers, Object Storage, and IAM.

plugins.name: cloud-netlify
plugins.description: Netlify development toolkit — Builds, Edge Functions, Functions (background / scheduled), Blobs, Forms, Identity, redirects, and Deploy Previews.

plugins.name: cloud-ibm
plugins.description: IBM Cloud development toolkit — VPC, Code Engine, IKS / Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud, Cloud Object Storage, Cloudant, IAM, and watsonx services.

plugins.name: cloud-alibaba
plugins.description: Alibaba Cloud development toolkit — ECS, ACK Kubernetes, Function Compute, OSS, RDS / PolarDB, VPC, RAM, ApsaraDB, and CDN. APAC and China-region patterns.

plugins.name: cloud-tencent
plugins.description: Tencent Cloud development toolkit — CVM, TKE Kubernetes, SCF (serverless), COS object storage, TencentDB, VPC, CAM IAM, and CDN. APAC and China-region patterns.
